summary: Will never ever understand how @twitter says they fight spam when you have a group of educators who gather same time every week and still #satchat gets crushed by spam. We have complained to @twitter for years, block everyone each week, but still becomes unusable.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Will never ever understand how @twitter says they fight spam when you have a group of educators who gather same time every week and still #satchat gets crushed by spam. We have complained to @twitter for years, block everyone each week, but still becomes unusable.
